deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy
deploy-bot: tag=v1.4.2-security.2026-03-20 commit=abcdef1234 env=eu-west-1/canary triggered_by=@maya change_window=now -> 10m
deploy-bot: rollout plan: 3 batches x 5 instances, health checks enabled, smoke tests after each batch
maya: watching canary logs, will report any anomalies :eyes:
samir: oncall — ping me if p95 > 120ms or error rate > 0.5% :phone:
deploy-bot: batch-1 applied -> 5/5 up
deploy-bot: running smoke tests (auth, /health, basic inference)
qa-bot: smoke result: /health ok, basic inference ok, auth-token-rotate FAILED (1/50) — details: token refresh returned 500 once
maya: hmmm, 1/50 but it's a user-facing flow for token refresh
jen: can we retry the smoke test on batch-1? might be transient
deploy-bot: re-running smoke on batch-1 -> auth-token-rotate FAILED (1/50) reproducible
atul: that's worrying. if auth rotation breaks production flows we should halt. what's the rollback cost?
maya: rollback is fast — single command to pin previous tag v1.4.1 and revert canary. prefer rollback to partial patch right now
samir: +1, we can't risk propagation during change window
deploy-bot: pausing remaining batches per policy
deploy-bot: initiating rollback to tag=v1.4.1 commit=12345fed env=eu-west-1/canary
deploy-bot: rollback in progress -> draining canary instances, redeploying previous tag
deploy-bot: rollback complete -> all canary instances running tag=v1.4.1
maya: verified smoke tests post-rollback: all pass
jen: creating follow-up issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421 — capturing auth-token-rotate failure, will attach logs and core dump
atul: assigning to @luca/eng-auth for triage, suggest pinning token library to previous minor while we investigate
samir: leaving a watch for metrics for 1 hour after rollback
maya: thanks everyone — no prod impact, will schedule a patch release after root cause is identified :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: note: deploy record: tag=v1.4.2-security.2026-03-20 -> rolled back after failing smoke auth tests. incident=false severity=low follow_up=INF-3421
